slides.text: We told the team the migration would ship on March 3rd.

citations.quote: We told the team the migration would ship on March 3rd

slides.text: That date went into the release notes, the customer email draft, and two internal Slack channels.

citations.quote: That date went into the release notes
It went into the customer email draft too, and into two internal Slack channels

slides.text: It was wrong. The project plan had always said March 10th.

citations.quote: The project plan had always said March 10th

slides.text: The 3rd was a typo from an earlier draft that got copied forward without anyone catching it.

citations.quote: The 3rd was a typo from an earlier draft, one that got copied forward without anyone catching it

slides.text: We corrected all three the same afternoon.

citations.quote: We corrected all three the same afternoon

slides.text: The migration did in fact ship on March 10th, on schedule once you're counting from the date that was actually right the whole time.
